shelfBands: const shelfBands = a=>{let out=[],sign=null;for(let x of a){let s=Math.sign(x);if(s!==sign){out.push(x);sign=s}else out[out.length-1]+=x}return out};
crateFields: const crateFields = s=>{let out=[],v='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(c==='"'){if(q&&s[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i++}else q=!q}else if(c===';'&&!q){out.push(v);v=''}else v+=c}return q?null:[...out,v]};
paintWindows: const paintWindows = a=>{let pts=[...new Set(a.flatMap(x=>x.slice(0,2)))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),out=[];for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){let x=pts[i-1],y=pts[i],hit;for(let r of a)if(r[0]<=x&&r[1]>=y)hit=r;if(hit){let p=out.at(-1);if(p&&p[1]===x&&p[2]===hit[2])p[1]=y;else out.push([x,y,hit[2]])}}return out};
routePieces: const routePieces = s=>{let a=[];for(let p of s.split('/')){if(!p||p==='.')continue;if(p==='..'){if(a.length&&!a.at(-1).startsWith('!'))a.pop()}else a.push(p)}return '/'+a.join('/')};
ribbonExpand: const ribbonExpand = s=>{let i=0;function seq(nested){let o='';while(i<s.length&&s[i]!==']'){let c=s[i];if(/[a-z]/.test(c)){o+=c;i++}else if(/[0-9]/.test(c)){let n='';while(i<s.length&&/[0-9]/.test(s[i]))n+=s[i++];if(s[i++]!=='[')throw 0;let v=seq(true);o+=v.repeat(+n)}else throw 0}if(nested&&s[i++]!==']')throw 0;return o}try{let o=seq(false);return i===s.length?o:null}catch{return null}};
counterUndo: const counterUndo = a=>{let n=0,st=[];return a.map(c=>{if(/^\+-?\d+$/.test(c))n+=Number(c.slice(1));else if(c==='save')st.push(n);else if(c==='undo'&&st.length)n=st.pop();return n})};
lOddMultiplicity: function lOddMultiplicity(a){let m=new Map;for(let x of a)m.set(x,(m.get(x)||0)+1);return [...m].filter(([x,n])=>n%2).map(([x])=>x).sort((a,b)=>a-b)}
lQuotedSplit: function lQuotedSplit(s){let a=[],v='',q=false;for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(c==='"'){if(q&&s[i+1]==='"'){v+='"';i++}else q=!q}else if(c===','&&!q){a.push(v);v=''}else v+=c}a.push(v);return a}
lBackspaceRuns: function lBackspaceRuns(s){let a=[];for(let c of s){if(c==='#')a.pop();else a.push(c)}let r=[];a.forEach((c,i)=>{if(i&&c===a[i-1])r[r.length-1]++;else r.push(1)});return r}
lIntervalParity: function lIntervalParity(a){let m=new Map;for(let [s,e] of a){m.set(s,(m.get(s)||0)+1);m.set(e,(m.get(e)||0)+1)}let keys=[...m.keys()].sort((a,b)=>a-b),on=false,start,r=[];for(let x of keys){if(m.get(x)%2){if(on)r.push([start,x]);else start=x;on=!on}}return r}
lStableTopo: function lStableTopo(ns,es){let out=[],done=new Set;while(out.length<ns.length){let n=ns.find(n=>!done.has(n)&&es.every(([a,b])=>b!==n||done.has(a)));if(n===undefined)return null;done.add(n);out.push(n)}return out}
lNestedMass: function lNestedMass(s){let d=0,n=0;for(let c of s){if(c==='(')d++;else if(c===')')d--;else n+=Number(c)*2**d}return n}
